items.description:
Tryn at Steenberg is a contemporary restaurant on the Steenberg Wine Estate in Tokai, housed in the farm's original wine cellar. It serves refined, contemporary cuisine with bold flavours, both in its indoor rooms and in a relaxed, family-friendly garden with views of the mountain and the vineyards.

The restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, with a summer menu and a focus on fresh, sustainable cooking that can be viewed online. Guests can reserve a table through the Steenberg Farm website, and the venue also hosts events and functions. It suits diners who want an elegant meal among the vineyards close to Cape Town.

Casa Woodstock Bar is a local bar and pizza restaurant on Albert Road in Woodstock, established in 2009 as a lounge and hangout for locals. Guests can watch the latest sport, enjoy a local beer or a classic cocktail made with fresh local produce, and order pizza from the menu.

The venue runs a weekly programme of events, including a ladies' night with buy-one-get-one-free pizza on Wednesdays, an open mic and art jam on Thursdays, and tequila specials on Fridays. Happy hour runs from 4pm to 6pm during the week. It also hosts artists who exhibit their art and craft, making it a space for local creativity.

Zone Fitness Cobble Walk is a gym inside Cobble Walk Shopping Centre on De Villiers Drive and Verdi Boulevard in Sonstraal Heights, Durbanville. The club features an aerobic studio and a fully equipped cardio and weight training section, and it is part of the Zone Fitness group with clubs across Cape Town.

Members can train on electronic cardiovascular equipment and in the weights section, with group fitness classes running alongside. The club describes itself as Cape Town's Northern Suburbs branch of Zone Fitness and invites visitors to join, making it a practical choice for residents of Durbanville and the surrounding northern suburbs.

Zenzero is a beachfront restaurant on the Camps Bay Promenade, known by its own description as having the most coveted terrace in Camps Bay. Its open-plan, wood-fired ovens take centre stage in an ocean-facing eatery, where indoor rooms and a terrace give diners a front-row seat over the beach, with a family-friendly approach to wood-fired fare from land and sea.

The kitchen builds its entire menu around fire, from coal-roasted seafood and skillet-seared meat to fire-roasted vegetables and wood-fired pizza, drawing on cooking styles from around the world; even the name, which means "ginger" in Italian, nods to that same idea of flavour built on heat. The restaurant trades from Shop 2A, The Promenade, on Victoria Road in Camps Bay, and suits diners, families and groups wanting a lively beachfront setting for breakfast, lunch, dinner or drinks.

Bellagio is a Mediterranean restaurant in De Waterkant built around seasonal, freshly sourced produce, with a menu shaped by classical Italian training. Specials such as seafood risotto, zucchini fritters and a well-regarded soufflé change regularly on the restaurant's specials board, keeping the food fresh rather than fixed to a single set menu.

The shady terrace suits long, lazy lunches, while the stylish interior is designed to evoke a trattoria overlooking Italy's Lake Como, complete with the smells of basil and tomato drifting from the kitchen. Freshly baked bread and desserts such as a berry and pistachio mille-feuille round out the menu. The restaurant trades from 74 Prestwich Street in De Waterkant with free on-site parking, suiting diners after a relaxed, unhurried Italian meal.

Café Caprice has been a fixture of the Camps Bay social scene since 2001, pairing elevated seaside dining with a well-known bar experience directly overlooking the Atlantic. The menu moves through the day, from breakfast by the sea and vibrant coastal cuisine through to sushi at sunset, with artisan cocktails served alongside.

Evenings at Café Caprice often stretch into the restaurant's bar and lounge side, where dinners can turn into dancing as the night goes on. Trading hours run from midday on Mondays through to midnight, 9am to midnight on Tuesdays to Thursdays, and 9am to 1am over the long weekend from Friday to Sunday. Based at 37 Victoria Road in Camps Bay, it suits beachgoers, diners and anyone looking for sundowners, cocktails or a lively evening out.

The Lighthouse Cafe brings a French Provençal and coastal feel to St George's Street in Simon's Town, with a light, airy space where customers are encouraged to linger over a book, a frothy cappuccino or time with friends. Its menu is kept deliberately short but still offers plenty of choice, including a changing specials board, with dishes freshly prepared by trained staff.

Food ranges from comfort classics to fresh seasonal dishes, built around locally sourced ingredients and served in what the café describes as a welcoming coastal cottage setting. The wine list is small but well chosen, and guests are welcome to bring their own bottle, subject to corkage. Trading from 90 St George's Street in Simon's Town, it suits those looking for a relaxed coastal meal, a coffee, or a spot to while away some time by the sea.

Weavewell manufactures heavy-duty industrial webbing and a wide range of tape products suited to industry applications, from standard 25mm webbing rated up to 700kg through to heavier 50mm webbing rated up to five tons. The range extends to lightweight and pebble-weave webbing, safety-belt webbing, backpack webbing, branded webbing, nylon cure wrap tape and custom speciality webbing made to order.

Its factory outlet and showroom in Elsies River is open to wholesalers, retailers and members of the public buying directly, with payment accepted by EFT, card or Snapscan rather than cash. The outlet trades from 14 Coleman Street, Monday to Thursday from 8:30am to 4:30pm and Fridays from 8:30am to 3pm, closed on weekends and public holidays, serving manufacturers, trade buyers and the public needing webbing, tape and ribbon products.

Studio Isobel Sippel is a textile and homeware studio inside The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, born, in the studio's own words, out of a deep love for textiles and a simple desire to create beautiful objects. Its pieces, among them cushions and tea towels, draw on South African landscapes for inspiration, with one recent collection shaped by the gemstones, rough mountains and quiet, open spaces of the Karoo and Northern Cape.

The studio describes texture as central to its work, making pieces for homes that are lived in rather than staged for show, and values the relaxed, creative atmosphere of its own workspace. Trading from Unit C103, 373-375 Albert Road in Woodstock, it is open to visitors on weekdays from 9am to 4pm and on Saturdays from 9:30am to 3:30pm, closed on public holidays, and suits customers and collectors seeking handcrafted South African textile pieces.

items.description:
PostNet Lakeside offers copying and printing, domestic and international courier services, stationery and a range of digital services from its branch in Lakeside Shopping Centre. As with other branches in the franchise, it gives individuals and small businesses in the area a local point of call for everyday printing, packaging and courier needs without having to travel further afield.

The branch trades Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 5pm and on Saturdays from 9am to 1pm, closing on Sundays and public holidays. Based at Shop 2A in Lakeside Shopping Centre on Main Road, Lakeside, it is a convenient stop for residents and businesses in the surrounding Lakeside and Muizenberg area needing courier, printing or stationery services during the working week and Saturday mornings.

PostNet Sun Valley provides copy and print, courier, stationery and digital services from its branch in Long Beach Mall on the corner of Buller Louw and Sunnydale Road in Sun Valley. It forms part of the wider PostNet franchise network, giving the Sun Valley and Sunnydale area a local outlet for everyday printing, packaging and courier needs.

Trading hours run Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm and Saturdays from 9am to 2pm, with the branch closing on Sundays and opening shorter hours of 9am to 1pm on public holidays. It is a practical option for individuals and businesses around Sun Valley needing stationery, courier collections or printing done close to home, without the need to travel into central Cape Town.

Shoprite Blue Downs is a supermarket trading from Blue Downs Shopping Centre at the corner of Hindle Road and Eersriv Way, stocking groceries, bakery and deli goods alongside everyday household essentials. It forms part of the wider Shoprite chain, giving households in Blue Downs and the neighbouring Eerste River area a full grocery offering under one roof.

The store's long trading hours, open daily from 8am to 10pm, make it a convenient option for shoppers fitting a grocery run around work or family schedules, running later into the evening than many smaller shops nearby. It serves local residents of Blue Downs and Eerste River looking for a nearby, well-stocked supermarket for their everyday shopping needs.

items.description:
The Pantry is a quick-counter café on the corner of Belvedere Road and Wyndover Road in Rondebosch, built around freshly baked goods, coffee and simple, ready-to-order food. Alongside its bakery counter it operates as a breakfast spot and sandwich shop, suiting customers who want something quick rather than a full sit-down meal.

It opens early, from 6:30am on weekdays, which suits customers calling in before work or school for coffee and something to eat, and keeps slightly shorter hours over the weekend, from 7:30am on Saturdays and Sundays. Trading from Rondebosch, it is a practical stop for families, students and commuters wanting quick coffee, baked goods, a sandwich or a light breakfast or lunch on the go.

items.description:
Beauty Place is a beauty salon in Richwood offering a focused range of treatments, including hair removal, facials and general skincare, makeup application for special occasions, and eyebrow and face threading. Clients can book a single treatment or combine several services in one visit, making it a convenient stop for regular beauty maintenance as well as one-off occasions.

The salon trades six days a week, closing only on Thursdays, which gives clients the flexibility to book facials, skincare treatments, makeup sessions or threading appointments around work during the week and over weekends, including Saturdays and Sundays. It serves a local clientele in Richwood and the wider Blouberg area who want accessible beauty treatments without travelling into the central suburbs.

Based in the La Piazza Complex on Nederberg Drive, Beauty Place suits clients looking for a straightforward, treatment-focused salon close to home, whether for a quick facial, a round of eyebrow or face threading, or makeup ahead of a special occasion.

Bella Pizza is a pizza restaurant and takeaway in Lakeside, serving a menu built around pizzas alongside pitas, burgers, ribs, salads and biltong. The mix gives customers more than a single-item menu, suited to groups wanting different orders from one kitchen.

The restaurant opens seven days a week from midday, making it a reliable lunch and dinner option throughout the week and over weekends. It accepts both credit and debit cards and offers free delivery, serving local residents who want a sit-down meal, a takeaway order, or pizza delivered straight to their door in the Lakeside area.

Trading from Lakeside Shopping Centre on Main Road, Bella Pizza suits families, groups of friends and anyone looking for a varied casual menu beyond pizza alone, with the convenience of ordering in when staying home.

items.description:
BODYTEC Sea Point is an EMS (electrical muscle stimulation) personal training studio offering 20-minute, full-body workout sessions designed to build strength and improve muscle tone without long hours in a conventional gym. The studio also offers a Hume Health Pod full-body scan, giving clients a way to track body composition and measure progress between sessions.

New clients can book a trial session before committing to a programme, with every workout guided by a personal trainer. The studio trades through the week into the early evening and on Saturday mornings, closing on Sundays and public holidays, suiting clients who want short, focused training sessions around work and weekend routines.

Based at Piazza Da Luz on Regent Road in Sea Point, BODYTEC Sea Point is a good option for people who want efficient, trainer-led EMS workouts and a body-composition scan rather than a standard cardio and weights session.

items.description:
Build It Bothasig is a hardware and building materials store serving homeowners, builders and contractors with everyday supplies for building, renovation and maintenance projects. Beyond stocking building materials, the branch offers practical in-store services including deliveries, key cutting, gas, credit facilities, paint mixing, building plan reading and board cutting, covering much of what a renovation or small building job needs in one stop.

The store is part of the Build it group, a network of more than 390 stores across Southern Africa that has supplied building materials for more than 35 years, giving the Bothasig branch access to a wide product range and established supply chains while still serving its own local customers directly. It trades through the week into the early evening, with shorter hours on Saturdays and Sundays.

Located within Bothasig Square on Vryburger Avenue in Bothasig, the store is well placed for homeowners and tradespeople tackling anything from small repairs to larger renovation and building projects in the surrounding area.

items.description:
Cash Converters Tokai is a secondhand goods store that buys and sells a wide range of pre-owned items, from smartphones, tablets and gaming consoles to smartwatches, outdoor gear and household electronics. Devices sold through the branch's CC Tech Certified programme are tested, data-wiped and quality checked before resale, giving buyers added assurance when choosing used electronics such as phones, tablets and games consoles.

The store operates on the usual Cash Converters model, where customers can sell unwanted items for cash or shop a constantly changing stock list online and in-store. Its current range spans everything from recent-model smartphones and tablets to gaming consoles, kayaks and outdoor lighting, reflecting the broad mix of secondhand goods that moves through the branch.

Trading from Main Road in Kirstenhof, Tokai, Cash Converters Tokai suits shoppers looking for pre-owned electronics and goods at lower prices, as well as people wanting to sell unwanted items rather than let them go to waste.

items.description:
Checkers Muizenberg is a full-range supermarket trading from The Muize Shopping Centre on the corner of Main Road and Atlantic Road in Muizenberg. Alongside its general grocery range, the store runs its own in-store bakery, butchery, deli counter and coffee shop, giving shoppers fresh produce and prepared food alongside everyday groceries in one visit.

The branch trades daily, opening from early morning through to early evening seven days a week, making it a convenient stop for locals doing a quick top-up shop or a full weekly grocery run. Customers have specifically noted the fresh produce and in-store bakery as standout features of this branch, alongside efficient service at the tills.

Serving Muizenberg and the surrounding Southern Suburbs, Checkers Muizenberg suits residents looking for a well-stocked, full-service supermarket with fresh in-store departments close to home.
